integrity: Theorem proved by exact algebra, interval expansion and finite Markov partition; accompanying symbolic checker verifies algebraic identities; publication priority is not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Exact real one-dimensional map at one algebraic control; no assertion on digitized hardware, invariant densities, global parameter entropy, or security. Earlier conference presentation was in 2021; January 10 2022 is the earliest day-specific online release reported by author bibliographic metadata, not necessarily the first conference availability.
title: Unique critical three-cycle and golden-mean entropy in a self-parameterized tent map
